hints.title: Coordinate Inversion Map
hints.text: Because grid values are distinct and bounded, precomputing coordinates for every value allows immediate constant-time location lookup.

hints.title: Orthogonal Offsets
hints.text: Retrieve cell coordinates (r, c) and iterate through four directional delta offsets (-1, 0), (1, 0), (0, -1), and (0, 1) checking matrix bounds.

hints.title: Diagonal Offsets
hints.text: Symmetrically iterate through diagonal delta offsets (-1, -1), (-1, 1), (1, -1), and (1, 1), summing in-bound cell values.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Query evaluation checks at most four neighbor cells.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning the entire grid to locate value takes O(n^2) per query.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n^2) coordinate table gives O(1) query response time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Creates clean position lookup table and handles boundary validations.
